title: Customer Care Operations Expert with French language
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Serve as the single point of contact for business partners regarding OTC process execution, fostering strong, solution-oriented collaboration.
Own the complete order cycle — from request to delivery — ensuring accuracy, process excellence, and a high-quality customer experience.
Manage inquiries with a first-time-right mindset, aiming for efficient, stable outcomes that reduce rework.
Resolve issues proactively, coordinating across functions, identifying root causes, and translating insights into business opportunities and service improvements.
Build and maintain strong partnerships with customers and key internal stakeholders across Western Europe, including regional sales offices, sales teams, shared service centers, business units, finance, regulatory.
Ensure structured and compliant documentation in instructional guides and SOPs, supporting process standardization and operational consistency.
Contribute to our continuous improvement roadmap by spotting patterns, proposing improvements, and helping implement new ways of working using Lean Sigma principles.
Champion a mindset of stability, quality, and continuous improvement in every interaction and decision.
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Bachelor degree
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both French & English -
French Native level required
Experience in customer service, order operations, sales support, or a similar environment
A strong sense of ownership and problem-solving ability
A continuous improvement mindset: you notice what can be better and act on it
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel), ERP, SAP, other tracking tools
Ability to prioritize, stay organized and adapt in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment with evolving standards
Comfortable working under pressure while maintaining quality and accuracy
A proactive, self-starting attitude with a focus on enabling smooth, stable operations
Passionate about customer experience and aware of how operational efficiency impacts customer satisfaction
We would prefer if you were proficient in project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Lean, Scrum).

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Analyse supply chain data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
Develop and maintain supply chain metrics and dashboards
Support inventory management and procurement activities
Coordinate with suppliers, manufacturing, global colleagues, and logistics teams to ensure timely delivery of materials
Assist in implementing process improvements and cost-saving initiatives
Prepare reports and presentations for management and utilize ERP systems (e.g., SAP/ Blue Yonder) for data analysis and process management
Ensure compliance with Medtronic’s quality and regulatory standards
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Engineering, or related field with 1-3 years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or related roles (internships included)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with ERP systems (SAP preferred)
Excellent communication and organizational skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment
Experience in medical device or healthcare industry, knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or other process improvement methodologies and advanced Excel, SQL, or data visualization tools (Tableau, PowerBI) experience are considered advantages for this role.

title: Senior Facilities Manager
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Provide strategic leadership and execution for multi-country facilities operations, ensuring alignment with global standards and regional regulations, and enabling strong communication between global leadership and local teams
Lead and develop a multi-layered, international organization of Facilities Managers, supervisors, and technical professionals, fostering accountability, inclusion, high performance, and effective remote collaboration across time zones and cultures
Drive cross-cultural collaboration and stakeholder management, using strong communication, influencing skills, and data-driven decision making to align diverse global stakeholders
Oversee the full lifecycle of facilities—including design, planning, construction, maintenance, security, janitorial, and grounds services—leveraging expertise in HVAC, electrical, plumbing, critical infrastructure, BAS, and CMMS systems
Lead project and program management initiatives across sites, including workplace and space planning, expansion, and continuous improvement efforts focused on sustainability and operational efficiency
Develop and manage financials across multiple sites, including budgets, capital planning, resource allocation, and forecasting, with detailed cost estimates for labor, materials, and equipment
Drive standardization of processes, policies, and best practices with appropriate local adaptation; ensure effective contract/vendor management; maintain HSE compliance; and monitor performance through KPIs to ensure consistent, high-quality service delivery
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent international qualification) required; advanced degree preferred
Minimum of 7+ years of relevant facilities management experience, including 5+ years in leadership roles
Proven experience managing multi-site, multi-country operations
Strong understanding of regional regulatory environments and compliance requirements
Demonstrated success in leading international teams and driving large-scale operational initiatives

title: Senior Tax Accountant Lawyer
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Responsible for managing tax compliance process across EMEA region and to provide tax advisory support to internal stakeholders as well as other internal reporting matters such as tax provisions
Keep abreast of the variances in tax legislations and assess impact on business and support in tax litigation procedures
Assist in the definition of structures and processes, M&A activities and other tax planning
Support in the definition of transfer pricing policies and other transfer pricing initiatives across EMEA
Works directly with external auditors and understands tax compliance
Coordinate with external advisors.
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in business, Economics or Law and between 4 and 6 years of relevant experience acquired in top advisory firms or in-house multinationals. International tax master’s degree as a plus
Strong knowledge of tax legislation within the EMEA region, or EU as a minimum (including but not limited to principles of corporate taxation, Double Tax Treaty clauses, BEPS)
Experience in managing tax compliance and advisory for multinational organizations (including but not limited to: CIT return preparation and review, WHT forms, participation exemption, etc.)
Some transfer pricing experience would be valued (involvement in value chain or IP project related preferred over transfer pricing documentation experience)
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills as well as embracement of tax digitalization culture
Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities, agility, strategic thinking and project Management.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Responsible for sales of Hernia and Wound management products to assigned hospitals and healthcare professionals, ensuring quality and consistency of service
Build and maintain strong relationships with key clinical and non-clinical stakeholders, driving product usage and market share through clinical selling
Manage multiple short- and long-term projects, including account management, tender optimization, and resolving client concerns
Provide product presentations, training (e.g., suture knot tying), and technical support to hospital staff and physicians
Lead business development activities: identify new sales prospects, prepare action plans, negotiate contracts, and expand client base
Conduct market analysis, monitor competitor activity, and prepare for upcoming tenders and market trends
Attend and facilitate congresses, workshops, and marketing functions while maintaining up-to-date product and market knowledge
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree and 3–5 years of proven sales experience
Highly motivated, enthusiastic, and adaptable
Excellent communication, organizational, and negotiation skills
Fluent in Dutch and strong English proficiency
Independent worker with strong time management
Service-oriented, sales-driven, and based in North Holland, Utrecht, or Gelderland

title: Senior Manager, Market & Customer Intelligence
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Lead and own the Market & Customer Intelligence Program, translating pilot learnings into a scalable operating model and governance framework
Drive the 12–18-month rollout roadmap across functions, countries, and use cases
Run monthly, quarterly, and annual intelligence cycles, synthesizing inputs into clear, actionable insights
Integrate signals from multiple sources into coherent, decision-ready narratives
Ensure high-quality standards, consistency of frameworks, and relevance to business decisions
Drive adoption across teams through enablement, support, and stakeholder engagement
Track KPIs, identify gaps, and continuously improve processes to establish the capability as a trusted enterprise asset
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Advanced degree in business, healthcare, economics, engineering, or a related field
Significant experience in strategy, intelligence, consulting, commercial operations, or healthcare transformation
Proven track record of leading large, cross-functional and multi-country programs
Strong understanding of AI-driven analytics, machine learning concepts, and data management principles (e.g., data lakes/warehouses)
Excellent strategic thinking, with the ability to translate business needs into AI-enabled solutions and clear, structured insights
Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing senior leaders and scaling initiatives from pilot to business-as-usual; fluent in English (additional languages are a plus)

title: Accountant External Reporting EMEA
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Gather and reconciliation of external audit deliverables
Support in preparing financial statements and tax accounting
Local reporting requirements
Initiate and follow up on tasks related to vendor invoice processing and payments by coordinating with the relevant teams
Complete regular tax reporting tasks
Support projects and initiatives for continuous improvement
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Bachelor’s (HBO) degree in Audit or Accounting
4+ years relevant working experience in accounting, audit or other finance roles
Good communication and coordination skills in English

title: Endovascular Clinical Specialist
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Analyse the marketplace, develop an effective territory/account sales strategy, and present the strategy to management to gain approval for implementation
Thoroughly comprehend and sell the indications and supporting evidence for the Therapy to Interventional Radiologists and Vascular Surgeons
Participate and assist clinical procedures until an account is established with therapy on your territory, occasionally assist colleagues in other regions
Perform all activities to maximize sales (in line with the sales strategy) from product introduction, presentation, and contract negotiation to completion of invoicing
Support the project and the market development for accounts in the assigned territory and spread over the South territory
Identify new opportunities to expand the use of the products in the territory including new indications by-products (depth), and wider product adoption in accounts (breadth)
Identify (or collaborate with clinical stakeholders to create) and leverage clear referral pathways internally in the hospitals to drive therapy expansion and service innovation
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Degree in Engineering, Life-Science, Marketing, Business Administration, Biology or another advanced degree
Min 3-5 years’ selling experience within the medical device industry, ideally in a sales and/or marketing/market development position
Proven track record of experience in developing and implementing strategies within the medical device industry
Thorough knowledge of the decision-making process with customers (economic buyer, reimbursement)
Excellent communication - and
conceptual/consultative
selling skills
Fluent in Dutch and English
Knowledge in the Vascular business is considered a valuable plus.

title: Sales Representative
description:

title: Training and Education Specialist
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Plan, deliver, and align internal and external training and education (T&E) strategies for both healthcare professionals (HCPs) and employees
Conduct regular needs analysis and develop strategic education plans to support business goals
Design, develop, and deliver HCP training programs, including procedure and competency-based education
Lead regional education initiatives and ensure consistency and quality across all programs
Build, manage, and maintain digital education resources; oversee access and track training execution and outcomes
Serve as the regional expert for CRM and CDS products, collaborating with regulatory teams to ensure compliance of educational materials
Partner with global and regional T&E teams to leverage resources and drive effective education solutions
Required Knowledge and Experience
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 3–5 years’ technical/clinical experience in an international setting
Background in adult education and strong medical/clinical knowledge, preferably in cardiovascular diseases
Technical aptitude, program management experience, and process-driven with analytical skills
Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills
Strong social, collaboration, and problem-solving abilities; adept at handling issues
Positive, proactive, and results-oriented personality; thrives in fast-changing environments; fluent in Dutch and English
We highly value candidates with a medical degree and a specialization in cardiology.

title: Patient Services Representative
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Be a trusted partner, educating and answering first level technical and lifestyle-related questions to our patients mostly via the phone
In cases where a resolution cannot be provided on the spot, you escalate to second level technical staff and follow the case to make sure it gets resolved
Ensure that the information about the call you have received is logged properly in our system. This is done according to the regulations and quality requirements that apply to a medical device company such as Medtronic
Maintain an up-to-date knowledge on our products and therapies. You will receive coaching and trainings to do this, yet we expect that you take your responsibility to learn and apply new knowledge very seriously
Contribute to the goals we set to improve as a department, as well as for your own personal growth
We work mainly during typical office hours; however, our work schedule may need to reflect that we are supporting patients in different European countries
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Excellent communication skills via phone in English and Finnish and preferably Dutch
Solid empathic and people skills demonstrating patience and analytical problem-solving skills
Positive, culturally sensitive attitude combined with the ability to quickly learn new technologies and applications
Computer and tech savviness in the use of MS Office
A background in providing patient support, experience in service focused areas and work experience in a contact center or technical support are considered advantages in this role.

title: Associate Technical Services Specialist Neuromodulation – Pelvic Health
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Provide world class technical support to our patients and customers
Serve as a liaison between patients and our technical and marketing partners
Have in-depth knowledge of all relevant products
Perform technical activities requiring considerable judgement and have ownership of projects
Responsible for ensuring all documentation/system entries are fully complete
Connect easily with the stakeholders and is customer focused.
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Excellent communication skills via phone and e-mail in English, German, and Dutch
Medical/Technical background with a relevant bachelor’s degree
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills that are balanced with speed and effectiveness
Highly organized with the ability to be flexible, multi-task and prioritize multiple assignments and to be able to contribute to/lead projects supporting the expansion of services in the future
Strong attention to detail and accuracy and a respected team player with strong interpersonal skills, who’s able to establish relationships with colleagues in other countries and departments.
Experience with working in a medical technical environment, in a technical support contact center and experience with analysing technical issues and processes for continuous improvement are considered advantages for this role. Besides this, proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience with Service Now are a plus.

title: Senior Process Development Engineer
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Design and develop production processes for advanced medical devices by translating product requirements into robust process outputs
Define required process inputs(/settings) and establish equipment requirements
Characterize and validate production processes through a strong understanding of input-output relationships and the establishment of effective process controls
Drive world-class product manufacturability by optimizing processes using Lean Six Sigma methodologies, with a strong emphasis on cost efficiency and consistency
Assess and improve product manufacturability through prototype build activities, providing structured feedback to product design teams to drive design improvements
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, applied physics, industrial automation or chemical engineering with 5+ years of relevant work experience
Mastering the Dutch & English language
Hands-on mentality, ability to work in multi-disciplinary teams
Preferably lean six sigma qualified (green belt or black belt)
Experience with process validation activities aligned with ISO 13485 requirements is preferred

title: Intercompany Export Analyst
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
The job entails close working relationships with local downstream Distribution Centers, regulatory, logistics operations, transport teams, trade compliance and our supply chain planning department.
You are the first point of contact for inquiries from Distribution Centers in Middle East, Africa, Central Asia, Russia, Eastern Europe, India, APAC, China and Latin America related to their stock transfer orders from our Distribution Centers in Heerlen, Netherlands or Rolo, Italy.
You enable smooth order and shipment processes and communications for these stock transfer orders and handle all incoming e-mails to (shared) mailboxes in an efficient, compliant and effective way.
You monitor the, mainly automatic, created stock transfer orders, deliveries and shipments at different stages in the process and monitor our lead-times in ERP (i.e. SAP) systems.
You are responsible for aging orders and providing daily/ weekly information about the open orders, deliveries and shipments to the distribution centers.
You are responsible for service complaints follow up with detailed root cause investigation and timely resolving the complaint.
You are responsible for performing root cause investigation for various issues, coordinate issues with other teams, and pay attention to detail to resolve issues.
You are responsible for performing analysis in our data tools (eg.: Celonis, PowerBI) to initiate Process Improvements, eliminate waste and focus on automation.
You have recurrent conference calls with your stakeholders to discuss processes, overcome obstacles and make agreements. You apply continuous improvement method/thinking while working on process improvements. You analyze and assess data and deviations to enable smooth process flows.
Required Knowledge and Experience:
HBO (Hoger Beroepsonderwijs/ Higher Professional Education) work & thinking level
2+ years’ experience in export-related customer care/service or order management
Fluent in English language in word and writing
Customer service focus and can-do mindset
Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)
Computer literacy (MS-Office & ERP Systems)
Analytical, problem solving and decision-making skills
Excellent Excel and PowerPoint skills
Strong sense of responsibility and high flexibility
Able to prioritize in a constantly changing environment and to deal with stress
Pro-Active role in communicating with all parties involved in regional processes, and identifying needs
Result orientation by using data, KPI’s/Metrics and making active use of tools and systems like Celonis, PowerBI and Lean Sigma
Preferred qualifications include prior experience working with Emerging Markets and/or handling Intercompany processes.

title: Senior Customer Service Representative with Italian language
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
We offer you a position where you support all day-to-day Order-To-Cash processes such as processing, monitoring and following up on, and invoicing orders
You record, analyse, follow up on and solve dispute situations like complaints, returns, etc. You efficiently answer sales team and customer requirements such as information requests, lead times, shortages and dispute solving, both on the phone and per e-mail
You execute your tasks for the most critical business groups within Medtronic; your operational support has a direct impact on improving the lives of our patients
You are the single point of contact for our business contacts for the execution of the OTC processes, within a cooperative relationship
You are a pro-active team player with a distinct drive for execution and results
You have a strong focus on customer satisfaction and can build lasting relationships with customers and colleagues in other departments and disciplines.
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree (or at least MBO+)
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Italian
2+ years of experience in customer service and order management
Computer literacy (MS-Office Outlook, Excel, Word)
Strong sense of responsibility and flexibility to take on additional tasks when required
Able to prioritize and work under pressure / cope with stressful situations, customer-focused and service-oriented.

title: Sustaining Engineer
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Perform functional testing on large capital equipment across electronic, mechanical, electromechanical, and optical systems to ensure full system compliance before shipment to customers
Test, troubleshoot, calibrate, adjust, diagnose, and maintain equipment, components, devices, and systems while setting up and operating machines, equipment, and fixtures required for repair and testing processes
Manage return inventory operations, including triage, inventory movements, preparation for failure analysis, and tracking of returned inventory locations
Support laboratory activities such as crating and uncrating high-level assemblies, spare parts handling, and other assigned operational tasks
Serve as a subject matter expert in the manufacture and repair of Class III medical devices, analyzing product failures, performing troubleshooting, identifying root causes, and verifying corrective actions
Lead and support failure investigations in cross-functional, multi-site environments (R&D, Regulatory, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality/Development, and
Manufacturing/Operations)
while using statistical techniques to provide evidence-based root cause conclusions
Drive complex experiments and testing on existing product lines to investigate manufacturing issues, analyze results, recommend improvements, produce reports, complete decontamination procedures on returned parts, and train or coach employees on advanced procedures and root cause analysis methods.
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in engineering with a minimum of 2 years of experience or master’s degree with 1 year of experience in the medical device industry with key technologies and processes related to the assembly and manufacture of Class II or III devices
Experience in leading and serving in a technical role for Failure Analysis or Reliability Engineering
Experience with Big Capital platform or complex mechanical system
Extensive knowledge and understanding of principles, theories, and concepts relevant to engineering, especially product development, manufacturing engineering, and failure modes and experience with a variety of software packages, e.g, Agile, SAP, etc are considered advantages for this role.

title: Senior Process Engineer
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Develop, improve, and simplify processes across the value chain, including assembly, warehousing, and quality control
Provide engineering support for troubleshooting, operator guidance, and continuous improvement
Facilitate daily Tier management huddles and lead problem-solving initiatives
Optimize productivity, capacity, process robustness, safety, and compliance using DMAIC, Flow Acceleration, SMED, and other Operational Excellence methodologies
Develop Standard Work, work instructions, and operator training tools to improve procedural adherence and operational performance
Plan, execute, and report on equipment qualification and process validation (Design of Experiments, FMEA, Statistical Process Control)
Lead engineering projects, ensuring solid planning, execution, monitoring, and reporting
Support process automation, digitization, and data-driven performance visualization, aligning with other enabling functions such as QA, Maintenance, EHS, and Operational Excellence
Required Knowledge and Experience:
10+ years of experience in multidisciplinary manufacturing environments, with proven success as a process or manufacturing engineer
Strong knowledge of manufacturing technologies, industrial engineering, assembly processes, and process automation
Demonstrable track record in performance improvement, productivity, and process robustness
Expertise in continuous improvement methodologies such as DMAIC, Value Stream Analysis, SMED, Material Flow, Tier Management, 5S, Flow Acceleration
Experience with Equipment Qualification, Process Validation, and statistical tools
Data-driven mindset, skilled in developing and visualizing performance management structures
Strong project leadership skills, delivering on time and exceeding expectations
Analytical, structured, and results-oriented, with the ability to work on the shop floor and engage with all levels of the organization
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in industrial engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
Fluency in English; Dutch proficiency preferred
Solid experience with Office 365 and business
intelligence/reporting
tools such as Power BI
Affinity for regulated, system-structured industries (medical devices, pharma, food, automotive)
Willingness to travel internationally (<5%) as required
Preferably Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt

title: Sr Manufacturing Supervisor.
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Support and contribute to the end-to-end door-to-door value stream within the Kerkrade Operations environment
Collaborate closely with Operations Supervisors and cross-functional teams including Finance, Quality, Engineering, Operational Excellence, Sourcing, Planning, and Distribution
Analyse and structure operational data, extract insights, and develop actionable controls to improve operational performance
Contribute to and lead continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and other operational excellence methodologies
Support the digitization of operational processes and help shape data structures that enable better decision-making and performance monitoring
Engage actively with stakeholders across the organization, from shopfloor operators to senior leadership, to drive alignment and operational improvements
Participate in and eventually lead cross-functional projects and transformation initiatives within the value stream
After the onboarding period, transition into supervisory and/or project leadership responsibilities within the Operations organization
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Information Management, or a related field.
Ambitious early-career professional with strong potential and motivation to grow within an operations and manufacturing environment.
Passion for products, processes, and people, with a strong interest in continuous improvement (knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, DMAIC; Green/Black Belt is a plus).
Hands-on and data-driven mindset, capable of structuring, extracting, and analysing data to generate actionable insights and operational controls.
Strong interest in digitization and data engineering, with the ability and curiosity to leverage data to drive operational performance.
Dynamic communicator, comfortable interacting with stakeholders at all levels—from shopfloor operators to senior leadership.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions such as Sourcing, Engineering, Quality, Sales, and Distribution.
Result-oriented and proactive, with leadership potential to contribute to and drive cross-functional initiatives and complex improvement projects across the value stream.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Provides Quality System support and guidance to maintain compliance with all FDA and international regulatory requirements
Supporting the Articulating Technologies QMS. Working as a pragmatic partner with the organization to ensure QMS processes related to General QMS & Pilot production are established, implemented and maintained in a compliant manner
Supporting the EU OU Surgical entities from a Quality Oversight perspective consisting of pro-active support (example helping, supporting entities with setting-up QMS processes, audits & certifications) & re-active support related to production quality issue resolution, PHO and FCA support)
Coordination and/or preparation of internal and external audits in accordance with regulatory standards (includes FDA and its equivalents outside the US as well as other government regulatory agencies / authorities) for the Operating Unit
Owns and drives Nonconform product Investigations, Root Cause Analysis and resultant Corrective Actions and Preventive Actions, performs trend analyses and report compliance observations to identify areas in need of improvement and investigates and resolves compliance problems, questions, or complaints received from other units of the company, customers, government regulatory agencies, etc.
Masters knowledge of applicable Quality, FDA (Food & Drug Administration) Medical Device Directives/ Regulation, and ISO (International Organization for Standardization) requirements through the updating of policies and procedures and acting as a liaison with appropriate policy experts
Excellent writing and editing skills, and computer skills and able to travel within EU and International approximately 10-25%.
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Relevant bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 2 years relevant experience
Demonstrated knowledge of all quality system elements and regulatory requirements (i.e. FDA, GMP, QSR and ISO 13485, and MDSAP) for finished medical devices with the ability to effectively implement and communicate those requirements in a government regulated healthcare industry and knowledge of Medical Device Manufacturing
processes/requirements
Effective usage of data analysis tools, analytical and research skills, and problem-solving techniques with keen attention to detail and simultaneous understanding of the "big picture" and desire to follow an audit trail to identify risks, non-conformances, true root cause, etc.
Outstanding written, oral communication, and presentation skills
Sound judgement, ability to make decisions, work independently and ability to manage and execute on multiple critical projects simultaneously. Capable to manage multiple priorities and escalate issues.
2 or more years relevant experience in a Medical Device Manufacturing setting or equivalent like packaging and labeling and/or distribution and experience supporting and or participating in regulatory inspections and audits are considered advantages for this role.

title: WM Area Coordinator
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Perform daily Warehouse Management (WM) activities within the assigned area
Oversee WM picking, packing, and staging activities to meet operational standards
Monitor stock accuracy and escalate discrepancies when identified
Facilitate the daily WM activities, ensuring tasks are completed accurately and efficiently
Act as a team lead, supporting the supervisor/manager in coordinating day-to-day operations

Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance safety, quality, productivity, and service levels

Practical experience and knowledge of warehouse management and logistics operations
English communication skills, both written and verbal
Computer literacy (MS-Office Outlook, Excel, Word)
Strong sense of responsibility and flexibility to take on additional tasks when required
Able to prioritize and work under pressure / cope with stressful situations, customer-focused and service-oriented.

title: Affera Mapping Specialist
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Provide proficient clinical and technical assistance to physicians and EP Lab Staff on the use of the Affera™ Mapping and Ablation System and our over-the-wire Pulse Select PFA ablation system
Provide technical expertise through sales presentations, product demonstrations, installation, and maintenance of company products, to ensure technology acceptance across various hospital stakeholders
Develop best-in-class professional customer relationships
Ensuring the highest level of expertise is attained and maintained by developing and maintaining comprehensive clinical and technical product knowledge and understanding competitive products, features, strengths
Ability to manage high-stress situations with a clear problem-solving mindset
Participate in regular territory reviews in the account team with the Sales Manager
Acts as a liaison between sales personnel and technical staff
Required Knowledge and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree or above
Min 2 years of experience in Electrophysiology
Background in Cardiology or a Cardiac Physiologist
Excellent communication and Influencing skills and the ability to build relationships with a wide range of clinical and non-clinical stakeholders
A positive person with strong entrepreneurial skills who brings passion, energy and excellence to his/her work
Clean driving license

title: Sales Representative
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Lead sales efforts within your designated territory to drive growth and expand the adoption of Medtronic’s Cardiac Surgery solutions
You are expected to meet and exceed established sales targets for your assigned territory
Build partnerships with surgeons, physicians, and hospital staff to understand their needs and deliver customized solutions that enhance patient care
Educate healthcare professionals on the clinical advantages of Medtronic’s Cardiac Surgery products through comprehensive product demonstrations and in-procedure support

Act as a trusted resource in the operating room by providing technical expertise and ensuring optimal product performance during surgeries

Sales experience in the medical device, healthcare, or pharmaceutical industry
Demonstrated ability to build relationships, show resilience and drive results in a competitive environment
Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, team player
Familiarity with operating room protocols and hospital purchasing processes
Fluency in Dutch and English

title: Customer Care Operations Specialist with Dutch language
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
We offer you a position where you:
Serve as the main point of contact for internal stakeholders, managing and resolving all operational and project-related inquiries to ensure alignment and effective collaboration
Map and analyze the complete Order-To-Delivery lifecycle across different scenarios and platforms, identifying process gaps and translating them into actionable projects

Bachelor degree
+2 years’ experience in customer care/service and order management

Skilled in identifying, analysing, and mitigating risks, as well as resolving issues as they arise

title: (Senior) Consultant Integrated Health Solutions Benelux (12 months contract)
description:
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Work with your team on projects across our partnerships to deliver quality and improve healthcare
